data.value: Via the clipboard (fast, the clipboard content is kept)

data.name: ClickHint
data.value: Hold Shift to use the other method.

data.name: RememberFolder
data.value: Start in the last opened folder

data.name: RememberFolderHint
data.value: Can also be switched in the popup with the pin next to the folder path.

data.name: PositionHint
data.value: Click where the pointer should sit when the popup opens, or press 1–9 like on the numpad. If there is no room on one side, the popup opens to the other.

data.name: StructureToolTip
data.value: Relative to the exe or absolute; environment variables like %USERPROFILE% work too

data.name: StructureDialogTitle
data.value: Choose the folder with your snippets

data.name: SearchContent
data.value: Also search the text inside the snippets

data.name: EvaluateScriptsToolTip
data.value: When pasting, e.g. {{ date() }} becomes today's date. Off: {{ … }} is pasted as is.

data.name: EvaluateKeyTags
data.value: Press key tags like {tab} and {enter} (fill in forms)

data.name: EvaluateKeyTagsToolTip
data.value: Snippets with key tags are typed: Max{tab}Müller{tab}{enter} fills in two fields and submits. Off: tags are pasted as is.

data.name: KeyTagsWindowGuard
data.value: Stop when another window comes to the front

data.name: KeyTagsWindowGuardToolTip
data.value: Protects against keys landing in the wrong program. Per snippet: {guard,off} turns it off, e.g. to automate the Start menu. Holding Esc always stops a snippet.

data.name: FormWindowChangedFormat
data.value:
"{0}" was stopped because another window came to the front.
If the snippet switches windows on purpose, start it with {{guard,off}}.

data.name: FormElementNotFoundFormat
data.value:
"{0}" was stopped: {1} found nothing in the front window within {2} seconds.
The element picker (crosshair in the popup or tray menu) shows how the element can be found.

data.name: FormWindowNotFoundFormat
data.value: "{0}" was stopped: no window for {1} came up within {2} seconds. Is the program open?

data.name: FormWindowNotActivatedFormat
data.value: "{0}" was stopped: the window for {1} couldn't be brought to the front.

data.name: TargetElevatedFormat
data.value:
"{0}" can't reach {1}: it runs as administrator, and Windows doesn't let normal programs send keys to it.
Start {1} without administrator rights (in its shortcut: Properties › Advanced/Compatibility › turn off "Run as administrator"). QuickHasteBot itself doesn't need them.

data.name: PickerElevatedFormat
data.value: {0} runs as administrator: Windows doesn't let QuickHasteBot see or fill its fields. Start it without administrator rights.

data.name: PickerIncludeWindowToolTip
data.value: Puts {window,…} in front, so the snippet first brings this program to the front, wherever you start it from.

data.name: PickerActionFocusToolTip
data.value: {focus,…}: puts the cursor into the field. Text after the tag is typed there, e.g. {focus,#email}max@example.com

data.name: PickerActionClickToolTip
data.value: {click,…}: clicks a button, link, tab or checkbox, like a mouse click.

data.name: PickerActionSetToolTip
data.value: {set,…,"value"}: fills a field directly, picks a dropdown option by its text or sets a checkbox to on/off. Edit the value in the tag below.

data.name: PickerTestToolTip
data.value: Runs the tag now in the program the element was picked in, like a snippet would. A click really clicks.

data.name: PickerTestDone
data.value: Test passed: the element was found and the tag ran.

data.name: PickerTestNoTag
data.value: That isn't a valid tag, e.g. {focus,#email}.

data.name: PickerTooltip
data.value: Pick a form field for key tags (crosshair)

data.name: PickerHint
data.value: Hold the mouse button on the crosshair, drag it onto a field, button or link and let go. The tag for it is then copied, e.g. {focus,#email}.

data.name: PickerDragging
data.value: Let go over the element. Esc cancels.

data.name: PickerChecking
data.value: Checking which selectors find exactly this element…

data.name: PickerCopied
data.value: Copied to the clipboard, ready to paste into a snippet.

data.name: PickerUnverified
data.value: None of these finds exactly this element, they are unchecked. Copied anyway.

data.name: PickerNothing
data.value: The element has no id, name or class to find it by. Click a field next to it and use {tab} instead.

data.name: RememberFolderTooltip
data.value: Start in this folder next time

data.name: FolderEmpty
data.value: This folder is empty. Ctrl+E opens it in Explorer.
